Stripe API

Base URL https://api.stripe.com

Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer sk_test_...

POST /v1/charges Create a charge.

GET /v1/charges/{id} Retrieve a charge.

POST /v1/customers Create a customer.

GET /v1/customers/{id} Retrieve a customer.

Webhooks

Verify signatures with HMAC in the Stripe-Signature header.

  • charge.succeeded A charge completed.
  • customer.created A customer was created.

400 invalid_request The request is invalid.
